items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: And as you mentioned Birmingham, you knew him, that's his name, blues. Birmingham was another one.

ctx.x: I wanted to ask you something else. Who were some of the good blues piano players around town when you were young?

Sam Henry, a friend called Sam Henry, old timer. Another friend called Kitchen, he was his name. Sam Henry, Kitchen. And another one called Ollie Sullivan. And another one called Ollie Sullivan. In that day they were good blue players. In that day Kitchen, Sam Henry, Ollie Sullivan. And as you mentioned Birmingham, you knew him, that's his name, blues. Birmingham was another one. And that's Kitchen, Sam Henry, Birmingham, Ollie Sullivan. Did they play anything else about blues? Well, they played a lot of old…
What would be some of the pieces?
